isolation.method: review-only: seek red tram to maximum positive-Y route point and suspend tramSystem.update; other world updates remain active

ambientReset.selector: unique unnamed AmbientLight directly under main scene, setupEnvironment source

lighting.weatherPolicy: review iframe forces weather=0 and weatherLocked=true; not persisted

walkable.method: FNV1a ordered world vertices including instance transforms rounded to 0.0001 m; compare external JSON, no persisted baseline

mainRock.method: FNV1a ordered world vertices including instance transforms rounded to 0.0001 m; compare external JSON, no persisted baseline

architecture.method: FNV1a ordered world vertices including instance transforms rounded to 0.0001 m; compare external JSON, no persisted baseline
architecture.note: All non-outline castle meshes excluding named mountain and vegetation classes; includes decorative meshes. Stable paths use same-name/type sibling ordinal, no UUID. Dynamic meshes may change and require classification, not automatic pass.

railCurveProtection.method: FNV1a world curve positions rounded to 0.0001 m, 3600 samples/lane

rail.method: 3600 stations/lane filtered to citadel bounds, 3 lateral x 3 heights, tangent rays 2 m; all named obstacles regardless review visibility

rootAcceleration.method: world triangle BVH, longest centroid extent median split; exact THREE.Ray.intersectTriangle; material Front/Back/DoubleSide retained

roots.method: trees/shrubs: lowest actual radial vertex across all instance parts; grass: legacy instance base vertices, or candidate each nonindexed triangle first two actual vertices (verified mountainGrass addSupportedGrass ends,tip layout); transformed by matrixWorld; radial ray to final study surfaces via independently validated exact world-triangle BVH
roots.limitations: Tree/shrub lowest vertex does not certify complete footprint; no continuous collision proof. Groundcover full surface support and non-study plants 未测.

summits.method: local eccentric eastern crest and descending spur; bounded target delta, protected deformation

summitCut.method: actual-silhouette-guided post-pass3 eastward descending crest subtraction
summitCut.evidence: r11-old-mountain-day-noCloud-plants.json silhouetteProfile; CPU geometric skyline, original ray error0

grass.method: candidate: both blade base endpoints projected into actual clipped support face; zero height offset

groundcover.method: low-frequency continuous coordinate colour; barycentric source shading normals; two shared-edge refinement levels then final-face continuous clipping; whole-face steep/protection gates retained; actual first-surface center test and grass endpoint tests

shader.note: Current linked programs and consumed GL error queue at check time; not proof of prior or future frames.

performance.note: rAF intervals and renderer counters, not GPU timing; browser scheduling affects result
